summary: Searches a fixed 8-entry array of strings on the object. Each entry's name string lives at byte offset 60 with stride 92 and is compared against a2 via strcmp. On a match the per-entry payload float at byte offset 92 * v2 + 144 is set to 5.0 and 1 is returned; if all 8 entries are exhausted 0 is returned. Invoked by UtilityFunction_b9c0.

local_names.this: owner object holding the fixed 8-entry string array and per-entry payload floats
local_names.i: pointer to the current entry name string, advancing by 92 per entry
local_names.result: return value: 1 on match, 0 when the scan is exhausted

operations.description: Scan the 8-entry string array: start i at this + 60 (first entry name, byte offset 60) and advance by stride 92 while strcmp(i, a2) is non-zero.
After each failed comparison increment the entry counter v2; when v2 reaches 8 return 0 (no matching entry).
On a match write the float 5.0 into the matched entry's payload at byte offset 92 * v2 + 144.
Return 1 on a match, 0 when the scan exhausts all 8 entries without a match.
Invoked by UtilityFunction_b9c0 (0045B9C0) to look up an entry by name and mark it selected.
